root_cause: Generated public surfaces can lose valid source edits when a downstream production builder rewrites the artifact from a canonical payload.

A governance-only follow-up is still a material Powerhouse change and therefore must carry Brain learning, an append-only activity ledger event and human-readable documentation in the same candidate lineage.
prevention: Determine the production-authoritative build point before editing any generated public surface.
Use the canonical builder input or an idempotent post-build projection and regress the real production builder wiring.
Treat borging/logging/documentation/skill updates as material closure work and include all required writeback artifacts in the same candidate before Required CI.
Require exact production identity and functional readback before LIVE_BEWEZEN for website changes.
